categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the automotive parts manufacturing industry, specifically focusing on automotive electric motors and fluid technology products. The business is organized into four main units: electric motor business, electric module business, driving vision cleaning system business, and thermal management system business. The company serves as a supplier of automotive components including cleaning pumps, cleaning systems, and various types of automotive motors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include harmonic magnetic field motor technology, platform-based and standardized product design, and fluid technology. Manufacturing methods emphasize intelligent automation with self-developed and integrated automated production lines featuring high-definition imaging systems, robotic arms, and advanced control systems. The company has developed proprietary capabilities in precision injection molding, stamping, and automated assembly processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major automotive manufacturers including BMW, Honda, Hyundai, BYD, Geely, and Great Wall, as well as global tier-one suppliers like Bosch and Continental. The company operates in three main market segments: original equipment manufacturer (OEM) market for new vehicles, secondary supplier market to major automotive component suppliers, and aftermarket/other markets through distribution channels. The company also serves industrial automation and emerging robotics applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Ningbo, Zhejiang Province. It has established production bases in Qingyuan (Guangdong), Shenyang (Liaoning), and Wuhan (Hubei). The company has expanded internationally with subsidiaries in the United States (Michigan), Thailand, and Singapore. Export markets include Europe (Germany, Romania, Italy), Asia (South Korea), and Americas (Mexico, USA).
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a mid-stream to downstream supplier in the automotive supply chain. It manufactures automotive components and systems that are supplied directly to original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers. The company has vertically integrated upstream by developing in-house capabilities for core materials (magnetic materials) and manufacturing processes (injection molding, stamping, automated assembly).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: developing harmonic magnetic field motor technology for improved power density and cost efficiency; expanding into new energy vehicle thermal management systems; developing intelligent cleaning systems for autonomous driving applications; pursuing industrial automation and humanoid robot motor applications; and implementing vertical integration through in-house magnetic material production. R&D investments emphasize lightweight design, low-noise performance, and system-level integration.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive components to original equipment manufacturers and tier-one suppliers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also generates revenue through aftermarket sales via distribution channels. Revenue streams include sales of cleaning pumps, cleaning systems, automotive motors, thermal management components, and integrated electric modules.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the global automotive micro-motor market against major international players including Asmo (Denso), Nidec, Bosch, Mitsuba, Brose, Valeo, Mabuchi Motors, and LG Innotek. As a Chinese supplier, the company benefits from domestic market advantages and cost competitiveness. The company has established itself as a qualified supplier to major global automotive manufacturers, positioning itself in the mid-to-premium segment of the automotive components market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized automotive components manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 923.4 million yuan, representing 25% growth from 738.8 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 202.1 million yuan in 2023, up 38.87% from 145.5 million yuan in 2022. The company has demonstrated consistent growth with expanding profit margins, driven by increased production capacity utilization and new product launches. Total assets reached 1.42 billion yuan at year-end 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced automation capabilities, platform-based product design enabling rapid customization, and integrated system solutions combining multiple technologies. Key competitive advantages include proprietary harmonic magnetic field motor technology offering superior power density and cost efficiency, vertical integration reducing supply chain risks, comprehensive quality management systems meeting international standards (IATF 16949), and strong customer relationships with leading global automotive manufacturers. The company emphasizes reliability, innovation, and cost-effectiveness in serving customers' evolving needs.
